name: xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-pro
description: MiMo-V2.6-Pro is the flagship of Xiaomi's open-source MiMo-V2.6 series, a trillion-parameter, natively omni-modal reasoning model released in September 2026 that takes text, image, video and audio input. Xiaomi built it for complex projects, long-horizon agents, coding, office and design work, cybersecurity, computer operation and research, with a 1M-token context. Pick it over MiMo-V2.6-Flash when task difficulty matters more than speed and volume.
